title: Explainable ML ensemble predicts diabetic foot ulcer outcomes, with randomized evaluation
summary: An ST-XGBoost and ST-MLP ensemble predicted cure, recurrence, amputation and mortality from 763 patients at two centers, and reached macro-averaged AUC 0.901 on 100 external patients (amputation 0.953, mortality 0.951, recurrence 0.820). In a randomized evaluation of 202 participants (200 analysed), AI-assisted recommendations scored 7.77 versus 6.47 for clinicians (mean difference 1.30, 95% CI 1.08-1.52). The outcome was a recommendation quality score, and recurrence estimates need caution.
ai_technology: Ensemble of single-task XGBoost and multilayer perceptron models with SHAP explanations

evidence.tested: The locked ensemble was externally validated and then compared with usual care in a randomized evaluation of recommendation quality.
evidence.unknown: Effects on patient outcomes are not measured; the external cohort is small. Abstract-based; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Gradient-boosted trees and neural networks predicted multiple ulcer outcomes to support physician recommendations.
